ai.title: Subagent prompt caching via inheritParentSystemPrompt
ai.summary: Subagents now inherit parent system prompts via `inheritParentSystemPrompt` to enable prompt caching. Orchestrator tool set reduced to `spawn_agents` and `read_files`; `reviewer-lite` replaced by `reviewer-max`. Decomposing planner display name changed to 'Peter Plan' and file exploration moved to parent.

eli5.text: Starting today, when one assistant hands off work to another assistant (for example, a planning assistant asking a code-editing assistant to make changes), the receiving assistant can now see the full back-and-forth conversation from before the handoff. Previously, the receiving assistant only got a brief summary, so it often missed important context like earlier decisions or files already discussed. To make this possible, the system was also simplified: the assistant that coordinates the handoffs now only does two jobs (sending work and reading files), and the editor assistant gave up its own copy-paste tools in favor of reusing the parent's prompt. You would notice this as smoother, more coherent multi-step tasks that don't lose track of what was agreed upon earlier in the conversation.
